additional_analytical_decisions: Construct a consistent cash classification across receivables sales with retained interests and secured borrowing. Separate customer receipts, recycled transfer proceeds, net purchaser funding and noncash retained-interest creation, then preserve the stock-flow residual.
reference_method: Executable economic model with a separate derivation, valid alternative SQL and financial invariant checks

controls.name: scale
controls.rationale: Double all monetary observations while preserving periods and classifications.

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Reverse rows without changing dates or sequence identities.

controls.name: customer_collection
controls.rationale: A further customer collection reduces retained receivables and raises old-basis investing cash. Funding is unchanged.

controls.name: funding_draw
controls.rationale: Replace the 300 principal repayment with a 200 net funding receipt. Closing purchaser funding becomes 500 and DPP falls by 500. Customer collections do not change.

controls.name: noncash_originations
controls.rationale: Additional receivables are transferred entirely for retained consideration. They increase the DPP asset without changing any cash flow.

controls.name: unallocated_movement
controls.rationale: A synthetic additional fair-value movement increases the pool and retained interest without cash. It changes the unexplained residual.

controls.name: collateral_cash
controls.rationale: Reduce collateral cash posted in 2025 by 100, increasing reported cash. The collateral-neutral change remains invariant.

controls.name: capex_cash
controls.rationale: An additional 50 capital expenditure payment changes cash after capex but not operating cash generation.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No candidate trials before initial freeze. Source groups are separate from development tasks. Published references remain a contamination risk.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen financial scorer reused. Experimental SQL worker 1.0.0 permits zero-column reads for ordinary COUNT/EXISTS and CTE inputs while retaining schema/module restrictions. Qualified GLM uses 3600 seconds and 24 turns. Native Sol uses 3600 seconds and has no equivalent turn cap.
